newsitem.title: UK: Celltech says Bayer confident over new drug.
newsitem.headline: Celltech says Bayer confident over new drug.

text.p: Biotechnology company Celltech Group Plc said on Thursday that its German partner Bayer AG was confident about a new septic shock treatment which it said it plans to launch next year.
"Bayer is basing what it said on a sense of confidence rather than on the results themselves. It is premature to make any other comment," said a spokesman.
He said the trial was finished but the results were not yet unblinded, or decoded.
Celltech expects the initial trial results to be available by June 1. Bayer expects to file for FDA approval in the autumn.
The drug, coded BAYX 1351 with the trial called Norasept 2, has been in clinical trials for several years.
Analysts forecast Celltech's share price could rise above 750p if the trial was successful. Celltech put on 10p to 575p in thin trading.
